reasoning: This is an abstract UI action glyph (export, share, or pop-out window) rather than a concrete subject. At small sizes it is nearly indistinguishable from many other box-and-arrow interface icons, and real tasks involving exporting or forwarding are almost always better represented by the specific object being sent (such as an email, spreadsheet, photo, or database).
